title: Fix the Silent Integer Overflow
description: The program should multiply two large numbers and print the exact result.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 10000000000, the true product of 100000 and 100000.
actualProblem: int in Java is a 32-bit type with a maximum value of about 2.1 billion. 100000 * 100000 (10 billion) exceeds that range, so the multiplication silently wraps around (overflows) to an incorrect, smaller (often negative) value instead of throwing any error.
explanation: Java's int arithmetic does not check for overflow — it wraps around silently. Using long (64-bit) for values that can exceed int's range avoids the overflow and produces the mathematically correct result.
